meta.name: smoke_types
assumptions: the suite's actuators are driven by the actuator driver (end of the safety path) of the matching function: BodyComfort_ClimateControlHVAC_031 -> ACT_HVAC_Cabin, BodyComfort_ExteriorLight_024 -> ACT_Light_Front, headlamp_left, ACT_Light_Rear, rear_lamp_left, Chassis_BrakeByWireActuation_006 -> ACT_Brake_Front, ACT_Brake_Rear, Chassis_SteeringSystemEps_012 -> ACT_Steering, Powertrain_TractionInverterControl_019 -> ACT_Motor_Front

one driver per actuator: a generated device merged into a suite actuator with its own driver function is commanded through that driver: BodyComfort_AntiTheftWarning_015 (hazard_lamps -> command to BodyComfort_ExteriorLight_024); Chassis_Esc_019 (brake_modulator -> command to Chassis_BrakeByWireActuation_006); Chassis_Epb_006 (parking_brake_actuators -> command to Chassis_BrakeByWireActuation_006)

subset smoke_types: the whole Autoware part (138 nodes), every endpoint's driving components and their chains (230 components fixed in every subset), random whole non-AD chains (seed 1) up to 80 % of 150 components, then the components with the most traffic to the included ones until 150
332 Autoware topics without a measured rate or size: median of the measured topics (39.997 Hz, 737 B)
messages: several topics between the same pair are one flow with the summed volume and the largest message
chain network budget = end-to-end bound minus the processing times of the members (measured mean for Autoware nodes where known, sum of the runnables' WCET for generated components)

1 traffic_light_node_container nodes: the measured host CPU share (about 83,000 DMIPS, the CPU side of GPU inference on the A100 host) capped at one target core (12250 DMIPS); the inference load is their HW_ACC / TOPS demand
138 Autoware nodes without ASIL: fail-operational -> ASIL D, nodes of the driving chain (sensing, localization, perception, planning, control, vehicle, map) -> ASIL B, else QM
units: cpu_req = DMIPS (configs/unit_classes.json cpu_currency), ram_req / rom_req = kB; a partition = one R-Car V4H-class block (49,000 DMIPS, 16 GB RAM, 64 GB flash), a cell up to 4 of them

generated devices reduced to 18 endpoints (user 2026-10-29; window and lock switches one per side): duplicates of the suite merged into it (inverter gate drivers -> ACT_Motor_Front, ESC brake modulator -> ACT_Brake_Front, EPS sensors -> ACT_Steering, defrost / temperature -> ACT_HVAC_Cabin), parts of one unit merged (e.g. seat buttons + position = seat controls), uncommon ones dropped (pedestrian sensors, active hood, AWD coupling, ride height, accelerometers, chassis sensor pool, parking buzzer); positions from the blocks of vehicle.json
generated devices with a 'direct' wiring are modelled as UART point-to-point cables

Autoware sensor drivers: velodyne driver per lidar (kit top/left/right/rear = suite front/left/right/rear, clone lidar_top = LIDAR_Top), traffic-light map-based detector per camera (camera6/7 = the first two cameras of the suite, camera8-13 the others), imu_corrector = IMU, gnss_poser = GNSS

shared endpoints take the fastest bus among their users' buses: column_switches (LIN -> FLEXRAY; users' buses CAN, FLEXRAY, LIN); door_lock_switches_left (LIN -> CAN; users' buses CAN, LIN); door_lock_switches_right (LIN -> CAN; users' buses CAN, LIN); rain_light_sensor (LIN -> CAN; users' buses CAN, LIN); cluster_display (LIN -> ETH; users' buses ETH, LIN); door_rear_left (LIN -> CAN; users' buses CAN, LIN); door_rear_right (LIN -> CAN; users' buses CAN, LIN); interior_lamp_front (LIN -> CAN; users' buses CAN, LIN); tailgate_module (LIN -> CAN; users' buses CAN, LIN)

bus capacity: a device with more data than one line of its bus carries takes the next faster bus: seat_controls (LIN -> CAN: 14.1 kbit/s > 13.4 usable on one LIN line); window_switches_left (LIN -> CAN: 17.3 kbit/s > 13.4 usable on one LIN line); window_switches_right (LIN -> CAN: 16.0 kbit/s > 13.4 usable on one LIN line)
direct wiring over all users: ACT_Steering (CAN -> SPI): the tightest chain budget of its users, 5.246 ms, cannot pay one CAN crossing

bus-length bounds: 'pairs' (up to 31 devices on one bus type; 'full' enumerates groups of up to 4 devices with every cell and pair of cells, millions of Steiner trees per line); the exact lazy cuts stay

bus lines available: {'CAN': 8, 'LIN': 6, 'FLEXRAY': 4} (v2 car: CAN 2, LIN 3, FlexRay 1): a line carries one ASIL group and a device of critical software sits on two lines, so per ASIL group two lines where a critical device exists, else one; a device whose chain cannot absorb one foreign frame has its lines alone: ACT_Brake_Front (CAN: budget 5.791 ms, own crossing 5.771 ms, frame 0.270 ms); ACT_Brake_Rear (CAN: budget 5.791 ms, own crossing 5.771 ms, frame 0.270 ms)
